before.trigger: Restart an offline-readiness timer while cache enumeration is forced unknown, then dispatch online.

rootCause: createOfflineCheck calls options.cancel(timer). Passing a native clearTimeout as this property invokes it with the options object as the receiver.
fix: Wrap clearTimeout in a callback so native timer cancellation is called without the options receiver.
limit: Cache enumeration is instrumented to exercise pending retries. Real browser timer APIs and real service-worker caching are used. This is not an AI or audio test.
